props.gloss_en: the mishna: if he established their offspring in place of their mothers, the offspring of the offspring are exempt
Rav Huna: the offspring are exempt, and the offspring of the offspring are obligated
Rav Yehuda: the offspring of the offspring are also exempt, and the offspring of the offspring of the offspring are obligated

the same holds where he did not establish them; what the clause teaches is that even where he did -- since it is the gentile's way to seize her offspring, and it is as if he had not established -- the offspring of the offspring are exempt and the next generation obligated
RSBG: even until ten generations they are exempt
for their liability is to the gentile
Rav Yehuda, who says the first tanna descends [to exempt] generations
Rav Huna, who says the first tanna does not descend generations
Rav Huna: RSBG refers to the 'established' clause, where [the first tanna] does descend generations
one who accepts tzon barzel from a gentile -- the offspring are exempt, and the offspring of the offspring are not
Rav Yehuda: read 'they and their offspring' [are exempt]
some say [the mishna reads]: they and their offspring are exempt
Rav Huna: read 'they and the offspring' -- exempt; the offspring of the offspring -- obligated

objections.gloss_en: תנן: העמיד ולדות תחת אמותיהן -- ולדי ולדות פטורין. טעמא דהעמיד, הא לא העמיד -- לא. תיובתא דרב יהודה!

answered_by.gloss_en: אמר לך רב יהודה: הוא הדין אף על גב דלא העמיד, והא קא משמע לן: אפילו העמיד נמי (16b.12: since the gentile's way is to seize her offspring, it is as if he had not established) -- see p_afilu_heemid

objections.gloss_en: תנן: RSBG -- אפילו עד עשרה דורות פטורין. בשלמא לרב יהודה (the first tanna descends generations) היינו דאמר אפילו; אלא לרב הונא, מאי אפילו עד עשרה דורות?

answered_by.gloss_en: אמר לך רב הונא: RSBG א״העמיד״ קאי דנחית לדרי -- see p_huna_rsbg_aheemid

objections.gloss_en: תא שמע: המקבל צאן ברזל מן הגוי -- ולדות פטורין, וולדי ולדות לא. תיובתא דרב יהודה!

answered_by.gloss_en: אמר לך רב יהודה, אימא: הן וולדותיהן -- see p_yehuda_eima_hen

objections.gloss_en: איכא דאמרי: הן וולדותיהן פטורין -- תיובתא דרב הונא! (the תא שמע of 17a.2 in this tradition's wording)

answered_by.gloss_en: אמר לך רב הונא: אימא הן וולדות -- פטור, וולדי ולדות -- חייב -- see p_huna_eima_hen
